coverage.description: round gates on disabled flag, daily stop and call budget, obtains pending batch, makes one external teacher call, then appends call count, verdict rows and ideas before write_world. Verdicts default U; parsed numbered lines overwrite earlier ones, accepting first T/F/U character; absent/invalid indices are ignored. write_world emits every cached T row with sources/notes then atomically replaces the derived world and attempts a brain update.
